checks.science_scope_limit: Scientific bits are checked within corresponding solver/thread scope, not claimed identical across solver/thread scopes.
checks.reference_limit: Same estimator at tolerance(1e-12), auto/one thread; tighter numerical reference, not independent external truth. Reverse fits match corresponding initial scientific bits.
checks.required_runtime_checks: No local rerun: no runtime/build-tool changes; already-qualified artifacts. Documentation checks and full push CI remain required.

route_signature_recipe: Merge common counters with each scope override to reconstruct the complete reported signature; SHA256 uses sorted JSON keys and separators comma/colon.
phase_semantics: Joint ordinary FeProjection contains setup/solve; FiniteSolve includes certification, not exclusively QR. Fresh canonical finite work also contributes.

StrictFinalSolve is the broad controller interval including candidate construction/assessment, score refresh and final Hessian work; its inner phases are not separately added to ordinary phase accumulators.
Solver durations overlap runtime phase durations. Independent phase medians need not sum to the median native duration.
Native total begins at native entry and ends before final runtime/COMPLETE store; the command includes frontend work. Unexplained remainder is not automatically overhead.
Missing phase values remain null, distinct from measured zero.

sampling.tool: Stock system sample, ten seconds at 1 ms; no profiling rebuild.
sampling.failed_attach: Initial sandbox attach could not examine the existing process. Retained failure directory; approved unsandboxed retry completed without sudo.
sampling.fit_protocol: One warmup then 120 repeated public fits on unchanged loaded data per capture; each return code checked, last published science/sample/route compared exactly to corresponding clean fit.
sampling.comparability: Separate diagnostic processes; repeated fits are not clean timing data. All binaries use the same public frontend.
sampling.count_semantics: Top-stack counts use the sampler collapsed section reporting counts >=5. Inclusive counts sum matching function nodes in the full graph across all threads; they include descendants/waits and are not wall-time fractions. Recursive occurrences can repeat.
sampling.ancestry_limit: Some Rayon worker stacks begin inside prepare_retained_solve and lose the upstream fresh/strict caller; these counts retain an unresolved canonical-worker context. Never infer their phase from elapsed-time proportions.
sampling.negative_evidence_limit: Covariance-factor symbols have zero or one inclusive occurrence here. Absence/inlining and short duration prevent a conclusion that this work did not run or contributes zero time.

compiled_work.observation: Two actual fdiv instructions normalize the same active row entry by the same reference norm in successive loops. The compiler has not eliminated this duplicate work.
compiled_work.inspection: Function excerpt extracted from stock ARM64 disassembly; complete binary disassembly was produced because the local Mach-O tool ignored symbol-only selection. No assembly or raw addresses beyond these function-relative image VMAs are committed.
compiled_work.speed_limit: Instruction removal is a hypothesis. Scratch-store and changed code-generation costs can offset the saved division; no speedup has been measured.

findings: Finite-solve time increases in all eight initial groups versus pre-M22; the four auto reverse groups retain that increase. Strict-final increments repeat for gravity/four and large/four/sixteen; large/one initial repair strict time is slightly lower and becomes higher in reversal.
Whole-command medians and current-versus-M22.1 comparisons are order-sensitive. Do not infer a uniform current slowdown or attach a precise percentage to all extra repair cost.
Inference is broadly stable across these bounded fits. Phase intervals and samples cannot assign all added cost to coefficient refinement or rule out covariance verification cost.

Current and M22.1 samples exercise the added refiner in fresh/strict canonical solves; explicit MAP also reaches ordinary frozen solves. Pre-M22 gravity profiles have no refiner occurrences, consistent with its absent source.

The refiner is an exercised source-local duplicated-work target; existing canonical products and parallel kernels account for much other sampled work. It is not established as the dominant whole-package bottleneck.

hard_problem_help.verdict: Sound source-local proposal for both production callers if canonical unique/increasing active positions are explicit at the refiner boundary. No policy waiver, new allocation, route fence or additional row scan required.
callers: solve_full_retained_rank: generated IDs ascending/unique; Cholesky retains order; CPQR validates unique IDs/permutation and sorts kept IDs.
stream_frozen_solve: rejects non-increasing active positions before work.
hard_problem_help.scratch: Dense, implicit and scratch readers overwrite every row entry from immutable storage. Delta reuse occurs after scoring; later passes and downstream computations refill. Rust borrows separate norms/response/bread from mutable row scratch.
hard_problem_help.coverage_gap: No current direct refiner tests; existing implicit rank-fallback fixture sets coefficient_tolerance=None. Duplicate design columns are not duplicate active indices.
hard_problem_help.execution_limit: Read-only source/invariant assessment, no builds/tests/timings or independent runtime execution.

next_proposal.change: Store the division result in workspace.row[position] during residual construction and read that already-rounded value in score accumulation.
next_proposal.precondition: Add active_positions.windows(2).any(|pair| pair[0]>=pair[1]) to existing validation before mutation. Preserve tolerance/rank-zero precedence and existing InvalidArgument message.
next_proposal.malformed_input_boundary: Duplicate/descending private indices currently pass local validation but no supported caller produces them; proposed rejection strengthens this private precondition.
next_proposal.arithmetic: Preserve FMA, weight*normalized_value*residual association, compensated accumulation, traversal order, four-pass/three-update ceiling, coefficient accuracy envelope and fail-closed behavior. No reciprocal multiplication.
regressions: Duplicate/descending active indices rejected before scratch/coefficients mutate; valid rank-zero behavior retained.
Noncontiguous active positions, unequal nonunit norms, unit/provided weights, nonzero correction and subsequent full-row refill; independent solution and parent bits, dense/scratch immutability.
Enable coefficient refinement in the existing implicit fixture; reuse strict fresh/scratch, omitted-row corruption, independent optimum, exhausted/nonfinite and error/unwind rollback witnesses.
next_proposal.gates: Full entrypoint/long oracles, exact qualified-parent replay/fixed-thread repeats, Mac/ABI, M22 PPML24 and saved-FE48, mapped licensed/allocation/transaction checks, Linux CI, compiled-work inspection, eight clean groups and bounded reverse-order confirmation; separate Astra extra-high review.
next_proposal.acceptance: No repeated regression or scientific/route/work change; reject rather than revive M23 adapter, weaken tolerance or add N/thread/weight/memory fences. No promised speedup.
